[[Gloomy Artifact]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Master of Misery]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Depths of Madness]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Death Magic]])
:[[Death Magic]] +1 (20% chance while using [[skills]])
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item has the same [[skin]] as a [[Bone Charm]].

==Replica==
